channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX share giveaway could be worth $18 billion: What will US children get?
item.description: Elon Musk plans to give every US child two SpaceX shares worth nearly $18 billion collectively, with one share from the company and another from him personally. He also plans to extend the giveaway annually.

item.title: Kalyan Silks promoters eye minority stake sale at up to ₹3,000 cr valuation
item.description: The deal may involve a 20% stake sale, with the capital likely to be a mix of primary and secondary share sales. Kalyan Silks has hired Mumbai-based investment bank O3 Capital to arrange the transaction.

item.title: GSK spinoff Haleon eyes billion-dollar Healthkart bet
item.description: GSK spinoff Haleon is looking to tap India’s fast-growing health and wellness market through a controlling stake in homegrown nutrition and supplements platform HealthKart. The deal, still in its early stages, could value the company at $1.2-1.4 billion, say people in the know.

item.title: Sleeping With a Subordinate Gets CEOs Fired. Except for Jensen Huang.
item.description: Across corporate America, lying to the board about a relationship with a subordinate has reliably ended the careers of powerful business leaders.

item.title: JioStar enters US streaming market with 7 Indian channels on Fubo; here’s how much it costs for Hindi entertainment
item.description: JioStar is bringing popular Indian TV channels, including Star Plus, Colors, MTV India and more in the US. The launch came with an introductory price, effective from November 16.

item.title: Can charity money be used to fight Tata Sons listing? Vijay Singh seeks urgent probe
item.description: Tata Trusts trustee Vijay Singh has approached the Charity Commissioner, questioning the use of charitable funds for a legal battle that could affect Tata Sons' listing.

item.title: Explained: What is ‘Starmind’? SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million space-based data centres - Full details
item.description: The project, called Starmind, is designed to harness solar energy in space to power AI computing systems, process data in orbit and transmit results back to Earth through high-speed laser links connected to the Starlink network.

item.title: JioStar faces fresh workforce changes as sale of 7 TV channels gathers pace, says report; what happens to employees?
item.description: JioStar is negotiating the sale of seven television channels by March 2027, as required by the Competition Commission of India. Employees associated with these television businesses will reportedly move to the acquiring companies as part of the transactions rather than face layoffs.

item.title: Raymond taps Jaideep Ahlawat as ‘Friend of the Brand’ to revive retro Bollywood fashion: All you need to know
item.description: Jaideep Ahlawat has joined Raymond Lifestyle’s Chairman’s Collection as ‘Friend of Brand’. Unveiled on Nov 25 in Mumbai, the collaboration draws inspiration from Bollywood fashion of 1960s, 1970s and 1980s, reinterpreting retro styles through contemporary tailoring, craftsmanship and bespoke luxury.

item.title: Singh, Srinivasan ask charity commissioner to rein in Tata suit
item.description: Two Tata trusts have challenged N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as Tata Sons chairman and sought to block his deciding vote. Vice-chairman Venu Srinivasan and trustee Vijay Singh separately asked Maharashtra’s Charity Commissioner to intervene.

item.title: Flipkart’s incoming CEO faces a multi-front battle
item.description: A stalled IPO, disgruntled employees and rising competition will test the new CEO, who must also manage a sprawling portfolio of capital-intensive businesses.

item.title: US-based GEF Capital prepares to ramp up India climate-tech investments
item.description: Over the next 4-5 years, the PE firm will invest in 3-4 mid-market companies every year with cheques ranging from $30 million to $60 million. The investments will be in companies across energy transition, electric mobility, industrial decarbonisation, sustainable agriculture, and water efficiency.

item.title: US closed cloud loophole for China. Now Nvidia’s B300 GPUs are on sale. Who’s buying? What changes for global market?
item.description: Nvidia's B300 chips are flooding the resale market after the US closed a cloud computing loophole for China. What does this mean for global AI demand?

item.title: TVS family dispute reaches Madras court: Is Lakshmi Venu seeking a one-third share? What we know
item.description: Lakshmi Venu has moved the Madras High Court seeking a share of the Venu Srinivasan family's assets. Here's what lies behind the TVS family dispute.

item.title: Wipro takes over 3,000 BP employees in new deal: What's behind the British oil giant's big move?
item.description: BP will transfer over 3,000 finance employees in India, Hungary and Malaysia to Wipro in 2027 as the energy giant reshapes operations and cuts costs.

item.title: Jet Airways grounded in 2019, now payment of ₹480 crore PF, gratuity dues with interest ordered by NCLAT: What we know
item.description: NCLAT directed Jet Airways’ liquidator to pay eligible employees their pending provident fund and gratuity dues, with interest, within 14 days. The payments are estimated at ₹480 crore. The airline suspended flight operations in April 2019.

item.title: Bombay HC to hear Tata Trusts' lawsuits against Chandrasekaran’s reappointment on Friday ahead of Nov 30 board meeting
item.description: The Bombay HC will hear two Tata trusts’ lawsuits challenging N Chandrasekaran’s reappointment as Tata Sons chairman and CEO. The trusts say the board resolution lacked the affirmative votes required by the company’s articles.

item.title: Top 10 names | EdelGive Hurun India Philanthropy List 2026: From Shiv Nadar & family, Gautam Adani to Bajaj
item.description: EdelGive Hurun India Philanthropy List 2026: 219 philanthropists donated a combined ₹11,554 crore in FY26, up 11% from the previous year. The top 10 gave ₹6,572 crore, accounting for 57% of total donations. Check full list here…&nbsp;

item.title: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Now S&P may downgrade its AA credit rating
item.description: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, but S&amp;P Global Ratings has placed its AA credit rating on watch for a possible downgrade over governance concerns.

item.title: Mint Explainer | AI, global headwinds test campus hiring for the class of 2027
item.description: Placement cells are widening recruiter outreach while firms rely on pre-placement offers across engineering and MBA campuses.

item.title: Why is GE Shipping buying its own stock instead of new ships with its Iran war windfall?
item.description: GE Shipping has decided to put off all fleet expansions until prices come down.

item.title: Shareholders who said no before now hold the key to APL Apollo's big bet
item.description: The vote comes amid a history of investor resistance, with five of 11 special resolutions at its 2025 and 2026 AGMs failing to secure the required 75% approval.

item.title: India orders tougher surveillance of packaged water, scrutiny set to cover PepsiCo, Coca-Cola
item.description: India’s food regulator has ordered states to intensify inspections and risk-based sampling of packaged and mineral water after a Bisleri sample was found unsafe. The planned checks will increase scrutiny of major brands as regulators step up enforcement across the food and drinks sector.

item.title: Tata trusts sue to strip chairman of casting vote, challenge Chandrasekaran's reappointment as Tata Sons chairman
item.description: The two trusts asked the court to stop any casting vote from being used at the 30 November meeting, where a plan to make Tata Sons public is expected to be discussed.

item.title: Noel Tata pushes for changes to Tata Sons' November 30 board agenda, seeks priority for issues raised by him
item.description: Noel Tata has sought priority for key governance issues at the November 30 Tata Sons board meeting, reiterating his opposition to N Chandrasekaran's reappointment and seeking the meeting's recording.

item.title: SpaceX to donate one share each to active Trump Accounts: Who is eligible, how to claim $1,000 — All you need to know
item.description: SpaceX said Wednesday it will donate one share of the company’s class A stock to every active Trump Account. From eligibility to process to open or activate your child's Trump Account — here's all you need to know.

item.title: Who is Rakesh Ranjan? Uber appoints ex-Zomato food delivery CEO to lead India and South Asia
item.description: Uber has appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as its president for India and South Asia, effective January 4, 2027. He previously spent eight years at Zomato and also worked with edtech firm Allen Online.

item.title: Norse Atlantic’s financial woes deepen: Flights cancelled, IndiGo deal ends, takeover talks on
item.description: Norse Atlantic’s financial crisis worsened as shares plunged, flights were cancelled and the airline disclosed talks over short-term financing and a possible takeover. Its wet-lease agreement with IndiGo has ended, while PIA has shifted cancelled Norse-operated routes to its own aircraft.

item.title: ‘To the dishes he washed’: On Jensen Huang's comeback, Denny's says 'something you just don't take off the menu'
item.description: The diner chain said its history with Jensen goes back much further, “to the dishes he washed, the guests he served and the work he still talks about with pride.”

item.title: SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million orbital compute modules: What it means for data centres in space
item.description: SpaceX has secured FCC approval to deploy 1 million orbital compute modules for data centres in space. The project, dubbed Starmind, aims to harness solar power but faces concerns over satellite collisions, atmospheric pollution and night-sky pollution.

item.title: Nvidia’s China link revealed? Investigation claims two US-based firms with Chinese owners are buying most advanced chips
item.description: Nvidia is selling its most cutting-edge chips to at least two companies that are US-based, but are actually controlled by Chinese-owned firms, a CBS News investigation found.

item.title: Mizuho, Avendus commence partnership a year after takeover announcement
item.description: Mizuho Securities and Avendus Capital have combined their operations following approvals, with Avendus retaining its brand and leadership team.

item.title: BNP Paribas moves up global systemic bank list, capital buffer rises
item.description: BNP PARIBAS-CAPITAL/:BNP Paribas moves up global systemic bank list, capital buffer rises

item.title: SpaceX Receives Government Approval to Launch Space Data Centers
item.description: The US Federal Communications Commission approved SpaceX’s request to launch as many as 1 million satellites for Elon Musk’s vision to build a network of data centers in orbit for complex artificial intelligence computing.

item.title: IPO on agenda: Tata Sons board to discuss listing plan at Monday's meeting
item.description: Tata Sons’ board agenda now includes an IPO plan, with a draft prospectus due within 90 days of shareholder approval and listing within the following 90 days.
